name: Spam Catcher » Numeric-label spoof domains >> Deleted Messages
comments: Heuristic spam catcher (priority 200, after all per-sender allowlist rules so it only sweeps un-claimed mail).

Matches sender domains containing 5+ consecutive digits: e.g. *.cgaux.org with 14-digit labels, inbox.<digits>foxnews.com, <digits>macrumors.com, notification.<digits>gcs-web.com, 59419.vidami.com, 83807.trionyx-sal.com.
No age guard: outright spam is deleted immediately. Validate with a dry run before relying on it.
